


This page provides a master index of all women raised to the rank of full [[Aes Sedai]] during the [[Third Age]].  Subcategories are also provided that further delineate women by power strength or position within the [[White Tower]].  This index does not provide a listing of - nor should it be confused with - [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai during the age of legends]].
